title: Goldreich–Levin candidate bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate among the first $n$ coordinates, and let $A$ be a finite family of subsets of those coordinates. Form the candidate family by taking, for each $S\in A$, the two sets $S$ and $S\cup\{i\}$. Its cardinality is at most $2|A|$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates
